sentences.en: Please pack the disks and hard copies into the briefcase.
sentences.zh: 请把磁盘和纸质副本放进公文包。

sentences.en: I saw him coming with his briefcase under his arm.
sentences.zh: 我看见他腋下夹着公文包走来了。

sentences.en: Reaching into his pocket, Dima pulled out a giant briefcase.
sentences.zh: 迪马从口袋里掏出一个大大的公文包。

senses.zh: (扁平的, 柔韧的, 装文件, 书报的)公文包。
